mapper.update: UPDATE budget_adjustment_review SET state_json=#{stateJson},version=#{version},status=#{status},updated_at=#{updatedAt},started_at=#{startedAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},checked_at=#{checkedAt},active_request_id=#{active},consumed_operation_id=#{consumedOperationId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{inputJson}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM budget_adjustment_review WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT state_json FROM budget_adjustment_review_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND review_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_no),0) FROM budget_adjustment_review WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND requested_by=#{actor}
SELECT * FROM budget_adjustment_review WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND requested_by=#{actor} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,NULL AS process_instance_id FROM budget_adjustment_review q LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND a.id=q.application_id WHERE q.status='QUEUED' OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY q.requested_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT process_instance_id FROM approval_submission_round WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND round_no=#{roundNo}
SELECT command_json FROM budget_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{consumedOperationId} AND review_id=#{id}
